_comment: Opted-in testers waiting for the owner. Rebuilt by aggregate.mjs on every run; editing it does nothing. To publish someone, copy their `key` into overrides.json -> wall_approved. To turn one down, leave it here: nothing is published from this file. Committed empty so the workflow's `git add` always has a path, and so an empty list can be told apart from a run that never got this far.
